acknowledgement_phrase: I ACKNOWLEDGE ONE BOUNDED BINANCE SPOT TESTNET FILL CAMPAIGN
intended_fill_method: One MARKET BUY using quoteOrderQty, followed by one MARKET SELL using only campaign-acquired base quantity after base-fee deduction and market-step rounding.
partial_fill_policy: Record partial execution, sell only proven acquired base, permit at most one deterministic cleanup sell, and fail the qualification gate.
ambiguous_outcome_policy: Query the deterministic client order ID after a transport, timeout, HTTP 5xx, or -1007 outcome; never blindly resubmit and never submit a cleanup order while the prior order outcome remains ambiguous.
idempotency_policy: Persist the run ID and all client order IDs before order entry; refuse to overwrite an existing campaign artifact.
commission_policy: Read GET /api/v3/myTrades for every order and account for every commission in its actual commissionAsset, including zero commission.
balance_reconciliation_policy: For every touched asset, final total balance minus initial total balance must exactly equal signed trade quantities and quote quantities minus commissions. Any unexplained asset delta fails.
pass_gates: Testnet origin, Spot scope, BTCUSDT symbol, and no production/live authority

all commission assets and amounts are present and nonnegative
all touched account balances satisfy exact delta equations
